email_verifications_recovery_token_check.name: email_verifications_recovery_token_check
email_verifications_recovery_token_check.value: "floorwalk"."email_verifications"."recovery_token_hash" IS NULL OR ("floorwalk"."email_verifications"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "floorwalk"."email_verifications"."purpose" = 'password_recovery')

users_role_site_check.name: users_role_site_check
users_role_site_check.value: ("floorwalk"."users"."role" = 'store_manager' AND "floorwalk"."users"."site_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("floorwalk"."users"."role" = 'admin' AND "floorwalk"."users"."site_id" IS NULL)

chat_messages_body_or_image_check.name: chat_messages_body_or_image_check
chat_messages_body_or_image_check.value: "floorwalk"."chat_messages"."body" IS NOT NULL OR "floorwalk"."chat_messages"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL

chat_messages_image_fields_check.name: chat_messages_image_fields_check
chat_messages_image_fields_check.value:
("floorwalk"."chat_messages"."storage_key" IS NULL AND "floorwalk"."chat_messages"."mime" IS NULL AND "floorwalk"."chat_messages"."size" IS NULL)
        OR ("floorwalk"."chat_messages"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "floorwalk"."chat_messages"."mime" IS NOT NULL AND "floorwalk"."chat_messages"."size" IS NOT NULL)

inspection_items_upload_metadata_check.name: inspection_items_upload_metadata_check
inspection_items_upload_metadata_check.value:
("floorwalk"."inspection_items"."uploaded_by_id" IS NULL AND "floorwalk"."inspection_items"."uploaded_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("floorwalk"."inspection_items"."uploaded_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "floorwalk"."inspection_items"."uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL)
